description: Reserved - The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - Changes to Sri Lanka Accounting Standards (E-Gazette)
reasoning: This gazette content publishes changes to Sri Lanka Accounting Standards (SLFRS) under the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. It contains detailed regulatory amendments to accounting standards and financial reporting requirements, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
